maya (PM): Quick thread 94 choose: 5-light partners (docs + 2 office hours) or 3-full (VPC+SSO+UI). Eng needs decision today.

eli (Eng): 5-light = 1 sprint (telemetry + runbook). 3-full = 3 sprints. If we promise full and miss, ops debt spikes.

jordan (Solutions): Sales wants 2 full for strategic accounts. Others okay with light. We can tag 2 as 'high-touch'.

rhea (ProdResearch): More partners = better prompt coverage. Telemetry mandatory for evals. Recommend light-by-default, full-by-request.

zoe (Legal): Any private deploys need a short addendum. I can draft a 1-pager fast. Also include a data-handling checkbox.

maya (PM): Proposed gates for light: partner signs addendum; telemetry enabled; smoke request within 5 days; <=2 high-sev regressions. For full: add SSO + sample VPC manifest before cutover.

eli (Eng): Add fallback: if full misses ETA, offer light track or defer. Also latency SLO: p50 <150ms or auto-fallback to hosted variant.

jordan (Solutions): I'll add intake checkbox "require private deploy" and priority field. Helps triage.

rhea (ProdResearch): Measurement plan: onboard_time, active_requests/week, eval_regressions, partner_sat (0-10). T+2 and T+6 surveys.

zoe (Legal): Addendum draft will include anonymized telemetry clause and liability cap.

maya (PM): Actions: Jordan -> intake checkbox + invite draft by EOD. Eli -> telemetry & fallback estimate by EOD. Rhea -> dashboard + survey templates by Fri. Zoe -> addendum draft by Fri. Meeting Mon 09:30 to finalize. :white_check_mark:
